create_video_writer: create a VideoWriter instance to write frames to an MP4 video file at a specified output path
write_frame_numpy: write a numpy array frame to the video writer with optional resize parameters
write_frame_pil: write a PIL Image frame to the video writer for later MP4 encoding
write_frame_matplotlib: write a matplotlib Figure frame to the video writer using plt.savefig
get_video_mp4: encode all written frames into an H.264 MP4 video using ffmpeg and return the output path
